title: Bodycam: Florida Woman Smeared Dog Poop on Neighbor’s Face at Trailer Park
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Florida woman being confronted by police after her elderly neighbor called 911 and said she smeared dog poop in his face. Kali Robertson was walking her dog in a St. Petersburg mobile home lot when she got into an argument with her neighbor after he said something that “upset” her. Robertson then took an “unsecured bag of dog feces” and shoved it into his face. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Get 50% off of confidential background reports at https://www.truthfinder.com/bodycamchannel

The 76-year-old Florida man said he always talked to her when she walked her dog, but that October day was different. After the incident, he called the police and made sure not to destroy or clean the evidence. Robertson initially tried denying what she did but ultimately confessed to the crime. She pleaded guilty to felony battery. Some would say Robertson makes for “one crappy neighbor.”
